tools.name: score_site
tools.description: Use this when the user asks whether a website is ready for AI agents, agent-ready, AI-agent friendly or WebMCP-ready, or what to fix so agents can use it. Scores one public website out of 100 for agent readiness and returns a grade, the fitness and adoption sub-scores, the five highest-value fixes,

tools.name: explain_check
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what a specific Agent Readiness finding means, why it matters to AI agents or how to fix it, usually after score_site. Explains one check: what it asks, why an agent cares, how it is weighted and how to fix it, with a code snippet where one exists. Answers from the rule s

tools.name: list_checks
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what the Agent Readiness Score measures or how it is calculated, rather than how one site performs. Lists every check in the rule set with its pillar, weight and question. Fetches nothing.

tools.name: get_badge_embed
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to show a site's Agent Readiness badge on that site. Scores the site if needed, then returns the HTML snippet for sites at grade C or better (bronze, silver or gold), or the reason and the first fixes when the site is not eligible. Returns HTML to paste; it installs noth

tools.name: watch_site
tools.description: Use this only when the user explicitly asks to be emailed when a site's Agent Readiness Score changes. Sends a confirmation email for monitoring that site. Use only when the user explicitly asks to receive a confirmation email for monitoring at the supplied address. Set sendConfirmationEmail to true

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_badge_embed, watch_site · Private data: score_site · Public sink: watch_site.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_badge_embed, watch_site · Private data: score_site · Public sink: watch_site

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
